triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f;\n}\n\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (isPairCulled(triI, triJ)) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        // The cheap geometric rejections are hoisted in front of the (expensive)\n        // visibility test. isRayBlocked() is side-effect free and the random points\n        // are already drawn, so this yields bit-identical results.\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors, local row block (localRows x N)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays, local row block (localRows x N)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix, replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix, replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source (replicated)\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // --- Row-block decomposition (used for Kij/Tau storage and all row-parallel loops)\n    std::vector<int> rowStart;      // size P+1, rowStart[r] = first row owned by rank r\n    std::vector<int> rowCount;      // size P, number of rows owned by rank r\n    size_t rowBegin = 0;            // first row owned by this rank\n    size_t rowEnd = 0;              // one past the last row owned by this rank\n    size_t localRows = 0;\n\n    // --- Pair-chunk decomposition (used only while computing the form factors)\n    uint64_t pairLo = 0;            // first linear pair index (i*N+j) of this rank\n    uint64_t pairHi = 0;            // one past the last linear pair index\n    uint64_t rngOffset = 0;         // number of RNG values consumed before pairLo\n    std::vector<uint64_t> pairLoAll;// size P+1, chunk boundaries of all ranks\n\n    long nonZeroKijLocal = 0;       // #Kij > EPSILON in the local row block\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return (i - rowBegin) * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Build the two complementary decompositions used by the solver.\n//\n// The row-block decomposition is a plain balanced split of the N triangles; it owns the\n// Kij/Tau rows and drives every row-parallel loop.\n//\n// The pair-chunk decomposition splits the row-major (i,j) sequence into P contiguous\n// chunks carrying an equal number of *non-culled* pairs. Non-culled pairs are exactly\n// the pairs for which the sequential code draws random numbers (NUM_RAYS * 4 values\n// each), so this balances the Monte-Carlo work and, at the same time, gives every rank\n// the offset it has to fast-forward its RNG to.\nstatic void buildDecomposition(SimulationState& state) {\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // --- Row blocks\n    state.rowStart.resize(g_size + 1);\n    state.rowCount.resize(g_size);\n    for (int r = 0; r <= g_size; ++r) {\n        state.rowStart[r] = static_cast<int>((static_cast<uint64_t>(N) * r) / g_size);\n    }\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) state.rowCount[r] = state.rowStart[r + 1] - state.rowStart[r];\n    state.rowBegin = static_cast<size_t>(state.rowStart[g_rank]);\n    state.rowEnd = static_cast<size_t>(state.rowStart[g_rank + 1]);\n    state.localRows = state.rowEnd - state.rowBegin;\n\n    // --- Per-row count of non-culled pairs (computed in parallel over the row blocks)\n    std::vector<int> rowWeight(N, 0);\n    for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& triI = state.triangles[i];\n        int cnt = 0;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i != j && !isPairCulled(triI, state.triangles[j])) ++cnt;\n        }\n        rowWeight[i] = cnt;\n    }\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, rowWeight.data(),\n                   state.rowCount.data(), state.rowStart.data(), MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Prefix sum of the weights: prefix[i] = number of RNG-consuming pairs before row i\n    std::vector<uint64_t> prefix(N + 1, 0);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + static_cast<uint64_t>(rowWeight[i]);\n    const uint64_t totalUnits = prefix[N];\n\n    // Map a work-unit index (index into the sequence of non-culled pairs) to the\n    // corresponding linear pair index i*N+j.\n    auto unitToLinear = [&](uint64_t unit) -> uint64_t {\n        if (unit >= totalUnits) return static_cast<uint64_t>(N) * N;\n        size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(std::upper_bound(prefix.begin(), prefix.end(), unit)\n                                       - prefix.begin() - 1);\n        uint64_t k = unit - prefix[i];\n        const Triangle& triI = state.triangles[i];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i == j || isPairCulled(triI, state.triangles[j])) continue;\n            if (k == 0) return static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * N + j;\n            --k;\n        }\n        return static_cast<uint64_t>(i + 1) * N;  // unreachable\n    };\n\n    state.pairLoAll.resize(g_size + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n        state.pairLoAll[r] = unitToLinear((totalUnits * r) / g_size);\n    }\n    state.pairLoAll[g_size] = static_cast<uint64_t>(N) * N;\n    // Chunks must tile [0, N*N) exactly, so a rank's chunk ends where the next one starts.\n    for (int r = g_size - 1; r >= 0; --r) {\n        state.pairLoAll[r] = std::min(state.pairLoAll[r], state.pairLoAll[r + 1]);\n    }\n\n    state.pairLo = state.pairLoAll[g_rank];\n    state.pairHi = state.pairLoAll[g_rank + 1];\n    state.rngOffset = (totalUnits * static_cast<uint64_t>(g_rank)) / g_size * (NUM_RAYS * 4);\n}\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh (redundantly on every rank: deterministic and cheap)\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    mprintf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    mprintf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Distribute the work\n    buildDecomposition(state);\n\n    // Initialize matrices (Kij/Tau hold only the locally owned rows)\n    state.kij.resize(state.localRows * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.localRows * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Redistribute the freshly computed form factors from the (work-balanced) pair-chunk\n// decomposition to the row-block decomposition used by the rest of the solver. Both are\n// contiguous partitions of the same N*N array, so this is a single MPI_Alltoallv in which\n// every rank only talks to the few ranks its chunk overlaps with.\nstatic void redistributeFormFactors(SimulationState& state, std::vector<val_t>& chunk) {\n    const uint64_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const uint64_t rowLo = state.rowBegin * N;\n    const uint64_t rowHi = state.rowEnd * N;\n\n    std::vector<int> sendCounts(g_size, 0), sendDispls(g_size, 0);\n    std::vector<int> recvCounts(g_size, 0), recvDispls(g_size, 0);\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n        // What we send to r: our chunk intersected with r's row block\n        const uint64_t oLo = std::max(state.pairLo, static_cast<uint64_t>(state.rowStart[r]) * N);\n        const uint64_t oHi = std::min(state.pairHi, static_cast<uint64_t>(state.rowStart[r + 1]) * N);\n        if (oHi > oLo) {\n            sendCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(oHi - oLo);\n            sendDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(oLo - state.pairLo);\n        }\n        // What we receive from r: r's chunk intersected with our row block\n        const uint64_t iLo = std::max(state.pairLoAll[r], rowLo);\n        const uint64_t iHi = std::min(state.pairLoAll[r + 1], rowHi);\n        if (iHi > iLo) {\n            recvCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(iHi - iLo);\n            recvDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(iLo - rowLo);\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Alltoallv(chunk.data(), sendCounts.data(), sendDispls.data(), MPI_FLOAT,\n                  state.kij.data(), recvCounts.data(), recvDispls.data(), MPI_FLOAT,\n                  MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    mprintf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // Private RNG, fast-forwarded to the position this rank's chunk starts at in the\n    // original sequential stream.\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n    rng.fastForward(state.rngOffset);\n\n    std::vector<val_t> chunk(state.pairHi - state.pairLo, ZERO);\n\n    bool printedFinal = false;\n    if (state.pairHi > state.pairLo) {\n        const size_t iFirst = static_cast<size_t>(state.pairLo / N);\n        const size_t iLast = static_cast<size_t>((state.pairHi - 1) / N);\n\n        for (size_t i = iFirst; i <= iLast; ++i) {\n            const size_t jBegin = (i == iFirst) ? static_cast<size_t>(state.pairLo - i * N) : 0;\n            const size_t jEnd = (i == iLast) ? static_cast<size_t>(state.pairHi - i * N) : N;\n\n            val_t* row = chunk.data() + (i * N + jBegin - state.pairLo);\n            for (size_t j = jBegin; j < jEnd; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n                row[j - jBegin] = computeKij(i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n            }\n\n            if (g_rank == 0 && jEnd == N && ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == N)) {\n                mprintf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, N);\n                if (i + 1 == N) printedFinal = true;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // The final progress line is emitted by the rank owning the last pair; make sure it\n    // appears exactly once, after all ranks are done.\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    if (!printedFinal) mprintf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", N, N);\n\n    redistributeFormFactors(state, chunk);\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    mprintf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    mprintf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // Fold the per-pair transfer weight min(Kij * area_j, 1) into the matrix once instead\n    // of recomputing it in every timestep. Entries that the sequential code skips (i == j,\n    // Kij <= 0) get weight 0 and therefore contribute an exact floating point zero, which\n    // lets the innermost loop run without those branches.\n    state.nonZeroKijLocal = 0;\n    for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n        val_t* w = &state.kij[(i - state.rowBegin) * N];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (w[j] > EPSILON) ++state.nonZeroKijLocal;\n            w[j] = (i == j || w[j] <= ZERO) ? ZERO : std::min(w[j] * state.areas[j], ONE);\n        }\n    }\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        const int ti = static_cast<int>(t);\n\n        for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n            const val_t* __restrict w = &state.kij[(i - state.rowBegin) * N];\n            const int* __restrict tauRow = &state.tau[(i - state.rowBegin) * N];\n            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                const int tauij = tauRow[j];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                if (ti < tauij) continue;\n\n                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                sumB += w[j] * state.radB[state.idxTN(t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij), j)];\n            }\n\n            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n        }\n\n        // Replicate this timestep's radiosities: every rank needs the full row to\n        // evaluate the delayed contributions of all triangles in later timesteps.\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, &state.radB[state.idxTN(t, 0)],\n                       state.rowCount.data(), state.rowStart.data(), MPI_FLOAT,\n                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            mprintf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    mprintf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    // The source signal is the same for every triangle; gather it into a contiguous\n    // buffer once so the inner loop streams two dense arrays.\n    std::vector<val_t> src(T);\n    for (size_t tt = 0; tt < T; ++tt) src[tt] = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, state.sourceIndex)];\n\n    std::vector<val_t> sig(T);\n\n    for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n        for (size_t tt = 0; tt < T; ++tt) sig[tt] = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n                sum += src[tt - t] * sig[tt];\n            }\n\n            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n                maxCorr = sum;\n                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, state.distances.data(),\n                   state.rowCount.data(), state.rowStart.data(), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Rank-0 part of the validation: all remaining inputs (distances, radB) are replicated.\nstatic bool validateResultsLocal(const SimulationState& state, int nonZeroKij) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    // Kij lives distributed over the row blocks, so its statistic needs a reduction.\n    // It is collected up front so that every rank participates in the collective before\n    // rank 0 may bail out of the checks.\n    long nonZeroKijGlobal = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&state.nonZeroKijLocal, &nonZeroKijGlobal, 1, MPI_LONG, MPI_SUM,\n                  MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    int okFlag = 1;\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        okFlag = validateResultsLocal(state, static_cast<int>(nonZeroKijGlobal)) ? 1 : 0;\n    }\n    MPI_Bcast(&okFlag, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    return okFlag != 0;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    mprintf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    mprintf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_size);\n\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            mprintf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    mprintf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"===================================\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n    mprintf(\"Timesteps: points\n        // are already drawn, so this yields bit-identical results.\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors, local row block (localRows x N)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays, local row block (localRows x N)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix, replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix, replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source (replicated)\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // --- Row-block decomposition (used for Kij/Tau storage and all row-parallel loops)\n    std::vector<int> rowStart;      // size P+1, rowStart[r] = first row owned by rank r\n    std::vector<int> rowCount;      // size P, number of rows owned by rank r\n    size_t rowBegin = 0;            // first row owned by this rank\n    size_t rowEnd = 0;              // one past the last row owned by this rank\n    size_t localRows = 0;\n\n    // --- Pair-chunk decomposition (used only while computing the form factors)\n    uint64_t pairLo = 0;            // first linear pair index (i*N+j) of this rank\n    uint64_t pairHi = 0;            // one past the last linear pair index\n    uint64_t rngOffset = 0;         // number of RNG values consumed before pairLo\n    std::vector<uint64_t> pairLoAll;// size P+1, chunk boundaries of all ranks\n\n    long nonZeroKijLocal = 0;       // #Kij > EPSILON in the local row block\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return (i - rowBegin) * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Build the two complementary decompositions used by the solver.\n//\n// The row-block decomposition is a plain balanced split of the N triangles; it owns the\n// Kij/Tau rows and drives every row-parallel loop.\n//\n// The pair-chunk decomposition splits the row-major (i,j) sequence into P contiguous\n// chunks carrying an equal number of *non-culled* pairs. Non-culled pairs are exactly\n// the pairs for which the sequential code draws random numbers (NUM_RAYS * 4 values\n// each), so this balances the Monte-Carlo work and, at the same time, gives every rank\n// the offset it has to fast-forward its RNG to.\nstatic void buildDecomposition(SimulationState& state) {\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // --- Row blocks\n    state.rowStart.resize(g_size + 1);\n    state.rowCount.resize(g_size);\n    for (int r = 0; r <= g_size; ++r) {\n        state.rowStart[r] = static_cast<int>((static_cast<uint64_t>(N) * r) / g_size);\n    }\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) state.rowCount[r] = state.rowStart[r + 1] - state.rowStart[r];\n    state.rowBegin = static_cast<size_t>(state.rowStart[g_rank]);\n    state.rowEnd = static_cast<size_t>(state.rowStart[g_rank + 1]);\n    state.localRows = state.rowEnd - state.rowBegin;\n\n    // --- Per-row count of non-culled pairs (computed in parallel over the row blocks)\n    std::vector<int> rowWeight(N, 0);\n    for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& triI = state.triangles[i];\n        int cnt = 0;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i != j && !isPairCulled(triI, state.triangles[j])) ++cnt;\n        }\n        rowWeight[i] = cnt;\n    }\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, rowWeight.data(),\n                   state.rowCount.data(), state.rowStart.data(), MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Prefix sum of the weights: prefix[i] = number of RNG-consuming pairs before row i\n    std::vector<uint64_t> prefix(N + 1, 0);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + static_cast<uint64_t>(rowWeight[i]);\n    const uint64_t totalUnits = prefix[N];\n\n    // Map a work-unit index (index into the sequence of non-culled pairs) to the\n    // corresponding linear pair index i*N+j.\n    auto unitToLinear = [&](uint64_t unit) -> uint64_t {\n        if (unit >= totalUnits) return static_cast<uint64_t>(N) * N;\n        size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(std::upper_bound(prefix.begin(), prefix.end(), unit)\n                                       - prefix.begin() - 1);\n        uint64_t k = unit - prefix[i];\n        const Triangle& triI = state.triangles[i];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i == j || isPairCulled(triI, state.triangles[j])) continue;\n            if (k == 0) return static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * N + j;\n            --k;\n        }\n        return static_cast<uint64_t>(i + 1) * N;  // unreachable\n    };\n\n    state.pairLoAll.resize(g_size + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n        state.pairLoAll[r] = unitToLinear((totalUnits * r) / g_size);\n    }\n    state.pairLoAll[g_size] = static_cast<uint64_t>(N) * N;\n    // Chunks must tile [0, N*N) exactly, so a rank's chunk ends where the next one starts.\n    for (int r = g_size - 1; r >= 0; --r) {\n        state.pairLoAll[r] = std::min(state.pairLoAll[r], state.pairLoAll[r + 1]);\n    }\n\n    state.pairLo = state.pairLoAll[g_rank];\n    state.pairHi = state.pairLoAll[g_rank + 1];\n    state.rngOffset = (totalUnits * static_cast<uint64_t>(g_rank)) / g_size * (NUM_RAYS * 4);\n}\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh (redundantly on every rank: deterministic and cheap)\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    mprintf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    mprintf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Distribute the work\n    buildDecomposition(state);\n\n    // Initialize matrices (Kij/Tau hold only the locally owned rows)\n    state.kij.resize(state.localRows * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.localRows * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Redistribute the freshly computed form factors from the (work-balanced) pair-chunk\n// decomposition to the row-block decomposition used by the rest of the solver. Both are\n// contiguous partitions of the same N*N array, so this is a single MPI_Alltoallv in which\n// every rank only talks to the few ranks its chunk overlaps with.\nstatic void redistributeFormFactors(SimulationState& state, std::vector<val_t>& chunk) {\n    const uint64_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const uint64_t rowLo = state.rowBegin * N;\n    const uint64_t rowHi = state.rowEnd * N;\n\n    std::vector<int> sendCounts(g_size, 0), sendDispls(g_size, 0);\n    std::vector<int> recvCounts(g_size, 0), recvDispls(g_size, 0);\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n        // What we send to r: our chunk intersected with r's row block\n        const uint64_t oLo = std::max(state.pairLo, static_cast<uint64_t>(state.rowStart[r]) * N);\n        const uint64_t oHi = std::min(state.pairHi, static_cast<uint64_t>(state.rowStart[r + 1]) * N);\n        if (oHi > oLo) {\n            sendCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(oHi - oLo);\n            sendDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(oLo - state.pairLo);\n        }\n        // What we receive from r: r's chunk intersected with our row block\n        const uint64_t iLo = std::max(state.pairLoAll[r], rowLo);\n        const uint64_t iHi = std::min(state.pairLoAll[r + 1], rowHi);\n        if (iHi > iLo) {\n            recvCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(iHi - iLo);\n            recvDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(iLo - rowLo);\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Alltoallv(chunk.data(), sendCounts.data(), sendDispls.data(), MPI_FLOAT,\n                  state.kij.data(), recvCounts.data(), recvDispls.data(), MPI_FLOAT,\n                  MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    mprintf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // Private RNG, fast-forwarded to the position this rank's chunk starts at in the\n    // original sequential stream.\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n    rng.fastForward(state.rngOffset);\n\n    std::vector<val_t> chunk(state.pairHi - state.pairLo, ZERO);\n\n    bool printedFinal = false;\n    if (state.pairHi > state.pairLo) {\n        const size_t iFirst = static_cast<size_t>(state.pairLo / N);\n        const size_t iLast = static_cast<size_t>((state.pairHi - 1) / N);\n\n        for (size_t i = iFirst; i <= iLast; ++i) {\n            const size_t jBegin = (i == iFirst) ? static_cast<size_t>(state.pairLo - i * N) : 0;\n            const size_t jEnd = (i == iLast) ? static_cast<size_t>(state.pairHi - i * N) : N;\n\n            val_t* row = chunk.data() + (i * N + jBegin - state.pairLo);\n            for (size_t j = jBegin; j < jEnd; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n                row[j - jBegin] = computeKij(i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n            }\n\n            if (g_rank == 0 && jEnd == N && ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == N)) {\n                mprintf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, N);\n                if (i + 1 == N) printedFinal = true;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // The final progress line is emitted by the rank owning the last pair; make sure it\n    // appears exactly once, after all ranks are done.\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    if (!printedFinal) mprintf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", N, N);\n\n    redistributeFormFactors(state, chunk);\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    mprintf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    mprintf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // Fold the per-pair transfer weight min(Kij * area_j, 1) into the matrix once instead\n    // of recomputing it in every timestep. Entries that the sequential code skips (i == j,\n    // Kij <= 0) get weight 0 and therefore contribute an exact floating point zero, which\n    // lets the innermost loop run without those branches.\n    state.nonZeroKijLocal = 0;\n    for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n        val_t* w = &state.kij[(i - state.rowBegin) * N];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (w[j] > EPSILON) ++state.nonZeroKijLocal;\n            w[j] = (i == j || w[j] <= ZERO) ? ZERO : std::min(w[j] * state.areas[j], ONE);\n        }\n    }\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        const int ti = static_cast<int>(t);\n\n        for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n            const val_t* __restrict w = &state.kij[(i - state.rowBegin) * N];\n            const int* __restrict tauRow = &state.tau[(i - state.rowBegin) * N];\n            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                const int tauij = tauRow[j];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                if (ti < tauij) continue;\n\n                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                sumB += w[j] * state.radB[state.idxTN(t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij), j)];\n            }\n\n            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n        }\n\n        // Replicate this timestep's radiosities: every rank needs the full row to\n        // evaluate the delayed contributions of all triangles in later timesteps.\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, &state.radB[state.idxTN(t, 0)],\n                       state.rowCount.data(), state.rowStart.data(), MPI_FLOAT,\n                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            mprintf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    mprintf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    // The source signal is the same for every triangle; gather it into a contiguous\n    // buffer once so the inner loop streams two dense arrays.\n    std::vector<val_t> src(T);\n    for (size_t tt = 0; tt < T; ++tt) src[tt] = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, state.sourceIndex)];\n\n    std::vector<val_t> sig(T);\n\n    for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n        for (size_t tt = 0; tt < T; ++tt) sig[tt] = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n                sum += src[tt - t] * sig[tt];\n            }\n\n            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n                maxCorr = sum;\n                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, state.distances.data(),\n                   state.rowCount.data(), state.rowStart.data(), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Rank-0 part of the validation: all remaining inputs (distances, radB) are replicated.\nstatic bool validateResultsLocal(const SimulationState& state, int nonZeroKij) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    // Kij lives distributed over the row blocks, so its statistic needs a reduction.\n    // It is collected up front so that every rank participates in the collective before\n    // rank 0 may bail out of the checks.\n    long nonZeroKijGlobal = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&state.nonZeroKijLocal, &nonZeroKijGlobal, 1, MPI_LONG, MPI_SUM,\n                  MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    int okFlag = 1;\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        okFlag = validateResultsLocal(state, static_cast<int>(nonZeroKijGlobal)) ? 1 : 0;\n    }\n    MPI_Bcast(&okFlag, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    return okFlag != 0;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    mprintf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    mprintf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_size);\n\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            mprintf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    mprintf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"===================================\\n\");\n    mprintf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n    mprintf(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n    mprintf(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n    mprintf(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n    mprintf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    mprintf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Initialize\n    SimulationState state;\n    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);\n\n    mprintf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Precomputation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto startPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeTimeDelays(state);\n    computeFormFactors(state);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto endPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto preDuration = RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n\n    // Skip ahead by `n` values of the stream produced by rand(). uniform_real_distribution\n    // <float> over mt19937 consumes exactly one 32-bit engine draw per value (24 mantissa\n    // bits < 32 bits of entropy), so discarding n engine draws is equivalent to n rand()\n    // calls. This lets every rank reproduce its slice of the original global RNG stream.\n    void fastForward(uint64_t n) { rng.discard(n); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n// True if the pair (i,j) is culled because both triangles face the same direction.\n// The sequential code draws no random numbers for such pairs, so this predicate also\n// determines the layout of the global RNG stream (see computeFormFactors).\ninline bool isPairCulled(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    return triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f;\n}\n\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (isPairCulled(triI, triJ)) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        // The cheap geometric rejections are hoisted in front of the (expensive)\n        // visibility test. isRayBlocked() is side-effect free and the random points\n        // are already drawn, so this yields bit-identical results.\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors, local row block (localRows x N)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays, local row block (localRows x N)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix, replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix, replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source (replicated)\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // --- Row-block decomposition (used for Kij/Tau storage and all row-parallel loops)\n    std::vector<int> rowStart;      // size P+1, rowStart[r] = first row owned by rank r\n    std::vector<int> rowCount;      // size P, number of rows owned by rank r\n    size_t rowBegin = 0;            // first row owned by this rank\n    size_t rowEnd = 0;              // one past the last row owned by this rank\n    size_t localRows = 0;\n\n    // --- Pair-chunk decomposition (used only while computing the form factors)\n    uint64_t pairLo = 0;            // first linear pair index (i*N+j) of this rank\n    uint64_t pairHi = 0;            // one past the last linear pair index\n    uint64_t rngOffset = 0;         // number of RNG values consumed before pairLo\n    std::vector<uint64_t> pairLoAll;// size P+1, chunk boundaries of all ranks\n\n    long nonZeroKijLocal = 0;       // #Kij > EPSILON in the local row block\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return (i - rowBegin) * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Build the two complementary decompositions used by the solver.\n//\n// The row-block decomposition is a plain balanced split of the N triangles; it owns the\n// Kij/Tau rows and drives every row-parallel loop.\n//\n// The pair-chunk decomposition splits the row-major (i,j) sequence into P contiguous\n// chunks carrying an equal number of *non-culled* pairs. Non-culled pairs are exactly\n// the pairs for which the sequential code draws random numbers (NUM_RAYS * 4 values\n// each), so this balances the Monte-Carlo work and, at the same time, gives every rank\n// the offset it has to fast-forward its RNG to.\nstatic void buildDecomposition(SimulationState& state) {\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // --- Row blocks\n    state.rowStart.resize(g_size + 1);\n    state.rowCount.resize(g_size);\n    for (int r = 0; r <= g_size; ++r) {\n        state.rowStart[r] = static_cast<int>((static_cast<uint64_t>(N) * r) / g_size);\n    }\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) state.rowCount[r] = state.rowStart[r + 1] - state.rowStart[r];\n    state.rowBegin = static_cast<size_t>(state.rowStart[g_rank]);\n    state.rowEnd = static_cast<size_t>(state.rowStart[g_rank + 1]);\n    state.localRows = state.rowEnd - state.rowBegin;\n\n    // --- Per-row count of non-culled pairs (computed in parallel over the row blocks)\n    std::vector<int> rowWeight(N, 0);\n    for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& triI = state.triangles[i];\n        int cnt = 0;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i != j && !isPairCulled(triI, state.triangles[j])) ++cnt;\n        }\n        rowWeight[i] = cnt;\n    }\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, rowWeight.data(),\n                   state.rowCount.data(), state.rowStart.data(), MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Prefix sum of the weights: prefix[i] = number of RNG-consuming pairs before row i\n    std::vector<uint64_t> prefix(N + 1, 0);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + static_cast<uint64_t>(rowWeight[i]);\n    const uint64_t totalUnits = prefix[N];\n\n    // Map a work-unit index (index into the sequence of non-culled pairs) to the\n    // corresponding linear pair index i*N+j.\n    auto unitToLinear = [&](uint64_t unit) -> uint64_t {\n        if (unit >= totalUnits) return static_cast<uint64_t>(N) * N;\n        size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(std::upper_bound(prefix.begin(), prefix.end(), unit)\n                                       - prefix.begin() - 1);\n        uint64_t k = unit - prefix[i];\n        const Triangle& triI = state.triangles[i];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i == j || isPairCulled(triI, state.triangles[j])) continue;\n            if (k == 0) return static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * N + j;\n            --k;\n        }\n        return static_cast<uint64_t>(i + 1) * N;  // unreachable\n    };\n\n    state.pairLoAll.resize(g_size + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n        state.pairLoAll[r] = unitToLinear((totalUnits * r) / g_size);\n    }\n    state.pairLoAll[g_size] = static_cast<uint64_t>(N) * N;\n    // Chunks must tile [0, N*N) exactly, so a rank's chunk ends where the next one starts.\n    for (int r = g_size - 1; r >= 0; --r) {\n        state.pairLoAll[r] = std::min(state.pairLoAll[r], state.pairLoAll[r + 1]);\n    }\n\n    state.pairLo = state.pairLoAll[g_rank];\n    state.pairHi = state.pairLoAll[g_rank + 1];\n    state.rngOffset = (totalUnits * static_cast<uint64_t>(g_rank)) / g_size * (NUM_RAYS * 4);\n}\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh (redundantly on every rank: deterministic and cheap)\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    mprintf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    mprintf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Distribute the work\n    buildDecomposition(state);\n\n    // Initialize matrices (Kij/Tau hold only the locally owned rows)\n    state.kij.resize(state.localRows * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.localRows * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Redistribute the freshly computed form factors from the (work-balanced) pair-chunk\n// decomposition to the row-block decomposition used by the rest of the solver. Both are\n// contiguous partitions of the same N*N array, so this is a single MPI_Alltoallv in which\n// every rank only talks to the few ranks its chunk overlaps with.\nstatic void redistributeFormFactors(SimulationState& state, std::vector<val_t>& chunk) {\n    const uint64_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const uint64_t rowLo = state.rowBegin * N;\n    const uint64_t rowHi = state.rowEnd * N;\n\n    std::vector<int> sendCounts(g_size, 0), sendDispls(g_size, 0);\n    std::vector<int> recvCounts(g_size, 0), recvDispls(g_size, 0);\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n        // What we send to r: our chunk intersected with r's row block\n        const uint64_t oLo = std::max(state.pairLo, static_cast<uint64_t>(state.rowStart[r]) * N);\n        const uint64_t oHi = std::min(state.pairHi, static_cast<uint64_t>(state.rowStart[r + 1]) * N);\n        if (oHi > oLo) {\n            sendCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(oHi - oLo);\n            sendDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(oLo - state.pairLo);\n        }\n        // What we receive from r: r's chunk intersected with our row block\n        const uint64_t iLo = std::max(state.pairLoAll[r], rowLo);\n        const uint64_t iHi = std::min(state.pairLoAll[r + 1], rowHi);\n        if (iHi > iLo) {\n            recvCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(iHi - iLo);\n            recvDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(iLo - rowLo);\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Alltoallv(chunk.data(), sendCounts.data(), sendDispls.data(), MPI_FLOAT,\n                  state.kij.data(), recvCounts.data(), recvDispls.data(), MPI_FLOAT,\n                  MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    mprintf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // Private RNG, fast-forwarded to the position this rank's chunk starts at in the\n    // original sequential stream.\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n    rng.fastForward(state.rngOffset);\n\n    std::vector<val_t> chunk(state.pairHi - state.pairLo, ZERO);\n\n    size_t printedUpTo = 0;  // last progress milestone reported by rank 0\n    if (state.pairHi > state.pairLo) {\n        const size_t iFirst = static_cast<size_t>(state.pairLo / N);\n        const size_t iLast = static_cast<size_t>((state.pairHi - 1) / N);\n\n        for (size_t i = iFirst; i <= iLast; ++i) {\n            const size_t jBegin = (i == iFirst) ? static_cast<size_t>(state.pairLo - i * N) : 0;\n            const size_t jEnd = (i == iLast) ? static_cast<size_t>(state.pairHi - i * N) : N;\n\n            val_t* row = chunk.data() + (i * N + jBegin - state.pairLo);\n            for (size_t j = jBegin; j < jEnd; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n                row[j - jBegin] = computeKij(i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n            }\n\n            if (g_rank == 0 && jEnd == N && ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == N)) {\n                mprintf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, N);\n                if (i + 1 == N) printedFinal = true;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // The final progress line is emitted by the rank owning the last pair; make sure it\n    // appears exactly once, after all ranks are done.\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    if (!printedFinal) mprintf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", N, N);\n\n    redistributeFormFactors(state, chunk);\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    mprintf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    mprintf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // Fold the per-pair transfer weight min(Kij * area_j, 1) into the matrix once instead\n    // of recomputing it in every timestep. Entries that the sequential code skips (i == j,\n    // Kij <= 0) get weight 0 and therefore contribute an exact floating point zero, which\n    // lets the innermost loop run without those branches.\n    state.nonZeroKijLocal = 0;\n    for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n        val_t* w = &state.kij[(i - state.rowBegin) * N];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (w[j] > EPSILON) ++state.nonZeroKijLocal;\n            w[j] = (i == j || w[j] <= ZERO) ? ZERO : std::min(w[j] * state.areas[j], ONE);\n        }\n    }\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        const int ti = static_cast<int>(t);\n\n        for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n            const val_t* __restrict w = &state.kij[(i - state.rowBegin) * N];\n            const int* __restrict tauRow = &state.tau[(i - state.rowBegin) * N];\n            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                const int tauij = tauRow[j];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                if (ti < tauij) continue;\n\n                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                sumB += w[j] * state.radB[state.idxTN(t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij), j)];\n            }\n\n            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n        }\n\n        // Replicate this timestep's radiosities: every rank needs the full row to\n        // evaluate the delayed contributions of all triangles in later timesteps.\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, &state.radB[state.idxTN(t, 0)],\n                       state.rowCount.data(), state.rowStart.data(), MPI_FLOAT,\n                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            mprintf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    mprintf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    // The source signal is the same for every triangle; gather it into a contiguous\n    // buffer once so the inner loop streams two dense arrays.\n    std::vector<val_t> src(T);\n    for (size_t tt = 0; tt < T; ++tt) src[tt] = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, state.sourceIndex)];\n\n    std::vector<val_t> sig(T);\n\n    for (size_t i = state.rowBegin; i < state.rowEnd; ++i) {\n        for (size_t tt = 0; tt < T; ++tt) sig[tt] = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n                sum += src[tt - t] * sig[tt];\n            }\n\n            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n                maxCorr = sum;\n                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, state.distances.data(),\n                   state.rowCount.data(), state.rowStart.data(), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Rank-0 part of the validation: all remaining inputs (distances, radB) are replicated.\nstatic bool validateResultsLocal(const SimulationState& state, int nonZeroKij) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    // Kij lives distributed over the row blocks, so its statistic needs a reduction.\n    // It is collected up front so that every rank participates in the collective before\n    // rank 0 may bail out of the checks.\n    long nonZeroKijGlobal = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&state.nonZeroKijLocal, &nonZeroKijGlobal, 1, MPI_LONG, MPI_SUM,\n                  MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    int okFlag = 1;\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        okFlag = validateResultsLocal(state, static_cast<int>(nonZeroKijGlobal)) ? 1 : 0;\n    }\n    MPI_Bcast(&okFlag, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    return okFlag != 0;\n}\n\n// computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const
